title: Fix black outline/background rendering artifacts in TUI
description:
Multiple visual rendering problems caused by unstyled strings and Unicode glyph artifacts:

1. Navigator (home screen): Bare string literals (" ", "  ") passed to lipgloss.JoinHorizontal have no background set, causing black boxes between/after elements. Fix: wrap spacers in lipgloss.NewStyle().Background(bg).Render().

2. Navigator icon: The ⬡ hexagon glyph (U+2B21) causes terminal cell-fill artifacts. Replace with ○ (U+25CB) in internal/services/dynamodb/service.go line 23.

3. Status bar: Manual left + strings.Repeat(" ", gap) + right concatenation uses unstyled gap characters. Rework layout to use lipgloss.JoinHorizontal with explicit backgrounds on all segments so the gap fill is properly styled.

4. Tables list selected row: The "  " prefix inside StyleListRowSelected.Render(...) is an unstyled string inside an outer styled Render, causing ANSI background reset artifacts. Ensure the prefix is explicitly styled with the highlight background before concatenation.

Files to change:
- internal/ui/navigator.go (line 101 — spacer strings)
- internal/services/dynamodb/service.go (line 23 — icon glyph)
- internal/ui/statusbar.go (lines 27-53 — rework layout)
- internal/services/dynamodb/tables.go (lines 243-248 — selected row prefix)
close_reason: Fixed all 4 rendering artifacts: styled spacers in navigator JoinHorizontal, replaced hexagon icon with circle, styled gap in statusbar, styled spacers in tables selected row
